findings.source_quote: “Doth not nature itself teach you?” … “We are exhorted to consider the lilies, the ravens, and the grass of the field.”
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri maneno ya nukuu kwa Kiswahili na uhifadhi rejea zake ikiwa zipo. Badilisha “maua ya lili, tai” kuwa maana sahihi: maua ya mashambani na kunguru; “ravens” si tai.
findings.translation_quote: “Doth not nature itself teach you?” … “Tunasukumwa kutafakari juu ya maua ya lili, tai na nyasi za uwanja.”

findings.source_quote: “Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?” (Job 6:5).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu kwa Kiswahili, ukihifadhi rejea kama (Ayubu 6:5).
findings.translation_quote: “Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?” (Job 6:5).

findings.source_quote: “Is any merry? Let him sing psalms” (James 5:13).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu kwa Kiswahili na tumia jina la kawaida la kitabu: (Yakobo 5:13).
findings.translation_quote: “Is any merry? Let him sing psalms” (James 5:13).

findings.source_quote: “And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God” (Ps 40:3). On 22 occasions, the Scriptures reiterate the phrase, I will sing.
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu na maneno “I will sing” kwa Kiswahili; hifadhi rejeo (Zaburi 40:3) na idadi 22.
findings.translation_quote: “And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God” (Ps 40:3). Mara 22, Maandiko yanarudia kifungu, I will sing.

findings.source_quote: “Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord” (Eph 5:19).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu kwa Kiswahili na tumia rejeo la kawaida (Waefeso 5:19).
findings.translation_quote: “Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord” (Eph 5:19).

findings.source_quote: “Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.”
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu hiyo kwa Kiswahili, kwa mfano: “Wayahudi hawashirikiani na Wasamaria.”
findings.translation_quote: “Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.”

findings.source_quote: “But the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life” (John 4:14).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu kwa Kiswahili na tumia rejeo (Yohana 4:14).
findings.translation_quote: “But the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life” (John 4:14).

findings.source_quote: “Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart” (Is 65:14).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu kwa Kiswahili na tumia rejeo (Isaya 65:14).
findings.translation_quote: “Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart” (Is 65:14).

findings.source_quote: “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird” (Rev 18:2).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu kwa Kiswahili na tumia rejeo (Ufunuo 18:2).
findings.translation_quote: “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird” (Rev 18:2).

findings.source_quote: “But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts” (Ps 22:9).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu kwa Kiswahili na tumia rejeo (Zaburi 22:9).
findings.translation_quote: “But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts” (Ps 22:9).

findings.source_quote: The Philistines “had filled them with earth” (Gen 26:15).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu kwa Kiswahili na tumia rejeo (Mwanzo 26:15).
findings.translation_quote: Wafilisti “had filled them with earth” (Gen 26:15).

findings.source_quote: “We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof. For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion. How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?” (Ps 137:2-4).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu nzima kwa Kiswahili; hifadhi rejeo na masafa yake kama (Zaburi 137:2-4).
findings.translation_quote: “We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof. For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion. How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?” (Ps 137:2-4).

findings.source_quote: “… And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace” (Jer. 29:5-7).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu nzima kwa Kiswahili; hifadhi rejeo na masafa yake kama (Yeremia 29:5-7).
findings.translation_quote: “… And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace” (Jer. 29:5-7).

findings.source_quote: “giving glory to God in the highest.”
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu hiyo kwa Kiswahili, kwa mfano: “utukufu kwa Mungu juu mbinguni.”
findings.translation_quote: “giving glory to God in the highest.”

findings.source_quote: “Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord … And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men” (Col 3:16, 23).
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu nzima kwa Kiswahili; hifadhi idadi, mpangilio na namba za mistari katika rejeo (Wakolosai 3:16, 23).
findings.translation_quote: “Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord … And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men” (Col 3:16, 23).

findings.source_quote: “the ravens”
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “kunguru” badala ya “tai”; chanzo kinarejelea ravens, si eagles.
findings.translation_quote: “tai”

findings.source_quote: “The dog barks at an intruder to drive him away”
findings.suggested_fix: Sahihisha sentensi ili iseme kuwa mbwa hubweka kwa mvamizi ili kumfukuza.
findings.translation_quote: “Mbwa huwauwa mduku kwa mgeni kumzuilia”

findings.source_quote: “the expression ‘happy as a lark’”
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia ulinganisho unaohifadhi maana ya kuwa na furaha sana kama lark; usitafsiri lark kama shujaa wa shambani.
findings.translation_quote: “furaha kama shujaa wa shambani”

findings.source_quote: “It is their waking thought as morning gilds the sky”
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri maana ya kuwa wimbo ni jambo lao la kwanza wanapoamka, wakati alfajiri inapopamba anga; “wazo lao wa kufungua macho” haieleweki hivyo.
findings.translation_quote: “Ni wazo lao wa kufungua macho wakati asubuhi inavyopendeza anga”

findings.source_quote: “We are not unaware of his devices...”
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri maana: “Tunajua hila zake...” Badilisha “Hatuwezi kusahau viwango vyake” kwa maana inayolingana.
findings.translation_quote: “Hatuwezi kusahau viwango vyake...”

findings.source_quote: “These are stopped-up wells like unto the wells that Isaac found upon his return to Gerar.”
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri “stopped-up wells” kama visima vilivyozibwa/vilivyojaa udongo, si tu visima vilivyoziba bila uwazi kuhusu hali yake.
findings.translation_quote: “Haya ni visima vimeziba kama vile visima ambavyo Isaki alipata aliporudi Gerari.”

findings.source_quote: “they lost their song.”
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri maana ya kupoteza wimbo wao, si kukosa wimbo wao kwa maana isiyo wazi.
findings.translation_quote: “walikosa wimbo wao.”

findings.source_quote: “we enact the grace of God”
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri maana ya kutenda/kuonyesha neema ya Mungu; “tunafanya neema ya Mungu” si Kiswahili cha kawaida na hubadilisha uhusiano wa maana.
findings.translation_quote: “tunafanya neema ya Mungu.”

findings.source_quote: “the innumerable hosts of our feathered friends who are thankful for God’s loving providence”
findings.suggested_fix: Hifadhi maana ya wingi usiohesabika wa ndege na shukrani zao kwa majaliwa ya Mungu yenye upendo; “ulinzi” ni finyu kuliko “providence.”
findings.translation_quote: “jeshi lisilohesabika la marafiki zetu wenye manyoya ambao wamejaa shukrani kwa ulinzi wa upendo wa Mungu.”

findings.source_quote: and ‘round me rings the music of the spheres.
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri kwa Kiswahili maana ya muziki wa anga unaonizunguka na kunivuma; kwa mfano, “na pande zote hunizunguka muziki wa anga.”
findings.translation_quote: na karibu nami kunatia sauti muziki wa anga.

gpt-4.1-mini.quality_note: Default cost-conscious candidate; not certified for theological accuracy in every language.

gpt-4.1-nano.quality_note: Lowest-cost option in this registry; benchmark before bulk publication.

gpt-5-mini.quality_note: Reasoning tokens consume output budget; benchmark total cost and quality.

gpt-6-astra.quality_note: Higher-cost manual recovery option. Documented API alias; no dated snapshot is published. Reasoning shares the output cap. Quality gates remain required.

gpt-6-luna.quality_note: Affordable default for new manual translation and review campaigns. Documented API alias; no dated snapshot is published. Reasoning shares the output cap. Benchmark theological accuracy; quality gates remain required.

gpt-6.1-sol.quality_note: Stronger downstream recovery option. Documented API alias; no dated snapshot is published. Reasoning shares the output cap. Quality gates remain required.
